about: Operations a signed-out caller and a visitor nobody invited may call. The team check fails on any other operation that answers either of them with anything but 401 or 403, and on an entry here that refuses a signed-out caller or that the surface no longer has. Add an entry only for an operation that is public by design, with the reason.

operations.reason: Ordinary HTTP on the desktop proxy path answers 404 to everyone. The socket upgrade on it is checked as WS /desktop-proxy/verifier.
